• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

further_explanations.title: Best Answer (Selected Solution)
further_explanations.author: GateOverflow Verified Solution
further_explanations.content:
Physical Address Division for Set-Associative Cache:
• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

further_explanations.author: Community Discussion

Average Memory Access Time (AMAT) = Hit_Time + (Miss_Rate × Miss_Penalty)

AMAT = L1_Hit + L1_Miss × (L2_Hit + L2_Miss × Main_Memory_Penalty).

further_explanations.title: Best Answer (Selected Solution)
further_explanations.author: GateOverflow Verified Solution
further_explanations.content:
For a k-stage pipeline executing n instructions with stall cycles:
Total Clock Cycles = (k + n - 1) + Total_Stall_Cycles
Execution Time = Total_Cycles × Clock_Period
CPI_effective = Total_Cycles / n

Substituting problem parameters confirms the exact result.

further_explanations.title: Best Answer (Selected Solution)
further_explanations.author: GateOverflow Verified Solution
further_explanations.content:
In a multi-level paging scheme:
• Page Offset Bits = log₂(Page_Size_in_Bytes)
• Virtual Page Number (VPN) = Virtual_Address_Bits - Page_Offset_Bits
• Number of Page Table Entries per page = Page_Size / Entry_Size
• EMAT = TLB_Hit × (TLB_Time + Mem_Time) + (1 - TLB_Hit) × (TLB_Time + (Levels + 1) × Mem_Time).

Execution Time = Total_Cycles × Clock_Period

Physical Address Division for Set-Associative Cache:
• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

Average Memory Access Time (AMAT) = Hit_Time + (Miss_Rate × Miss_Penalty)

AMAT = L1_Hit + L1_Miss × (L2_Hit + L2_Miss × Main_Memory_Penalty).

further_explanations.title: Best Answer (Selected Solution)
further_explanations.author: GateOverflow Verified Solution
further_explanations.content:
Physical Address Division for Set-Associative Cache:
• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

further_explanations.title: Alternative Method: AMAT Formula Derivation
further_explanations.author: Community Discussion
further_explanations.content:
Average Memory Access Time (AMAT) = Hit_Time + (Miss_Rate × Miss_Penalty)
For multi-level cache:
AMAT = L1_Hit + L1_Miss × (L2_Hit + L2_Miss × Main_Memory_Penalty).

• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

further_explanations.title: Best Answer (Selected Solution)
further_explanations.author: GateOverflow Verified Solution
further_explanations.content:
Physical Address Division for Set-Associative Cache:
• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

further_explanations.author: Community Discussion
further_explanations.content:
Average Memory Access Time (AMAT) = Hit_Time + (Miss_Rate × Miss_Penalty)
For multi-level cache:
AMAT = L1_Hit + L1_Miss × (L2_Hit + L2_Miss × Main_Memory_Penalty).

Total Clock Cycles = (k + n - 1) + Total_Stall_Cycles

CPI_effective = Total_Cycles / n

3. Branch penalties introduce flush cycles on misprediction.

further_explanations.title: Best Answer (Selected Solution)
further_explanations.author: GateOverflow Verified Solution
further_explanations.content:
Physical Address Division for Set-Associative Cache:
• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

further_explanations.author: Community Discussion
further_explanations.content:
Average Memory Access Time (AMAT) = Hit_Time + (Miss_Rate × Miss_Penalty)

AMAT = L1_Hit + L1_Miss × (L2_Hit + L2_Miss × Main_Memory_Penalty).

• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

• Block Offset Bits = log₂(Block_Size_in_Bytes)
• Number of Sets = Total_Cache_Size / (Block_Size × Set_Associativity)
• Set Index Bits = log₂(Number_of_Sets)
• Tag Bits = Total_Physical_Address_Bits - (Set_Index_Bits + Block_Offset_Bits)

Calculation yields the exact tag and index values.

AMAT = L1_Hit + L1_Miss × (L2_Hit + L2_Miss × Main_Memory_Penalty).
